assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production-ready transparent-background 2D environment sprite for the child-friendly fantasy exploration game Meu Pet Virtual. One open arched entrance facing down toward the viewer, empty interior with a simple beige cushion. Style: softly painted casual RPG illustration with tactile stone and wood, warm upper-left sunlight, gentle ambient shading, rich clear silhouette, NOT vector art, NOT a photograph, NOT low-poly. Camera: elevated three-quarter oblique view approximately 40 degrees from above, roof visible, front entrance slightly turned toward lower-right, consistent top-down game prop perspective. Composition: isolated single complete hut centered, generous transparent margin on every side, entire roof and grounded bottom sill visible, compact roughly square silhouette, no cropping. Constraints: true alpha transparency, no background scene, no terrain island, no floor slab, no surrounding lake, no other buildings, no character, no text, no watermark, no UI, no symbols. Tiny reeds may attach to hut base, but avoid detached objects or large shadows extending beyond the shelter.
assets.visual_notes: Blue-gray rounded river stone, golden reed roof, pale driftwood frame; top-left light. Whole sill and roof intact. Some extremely faint alpha edge pixels outside visible footprint retained unchanged.
